name: hevy
description: Agent-native HEVY connector with complete-history analytics, a private local training warehouse, and safe routine and template management.

interface.shortDescription: Your complete HEVY history, built for agents.
interface.longDescription: A local-first HEVY connector for ChatGPT and Codex. It combines safe access to workouts, routines, templates, folders, measurements, and profile data with a private SQLite warehouse that lets agents query years of training history in one read-only SQL call.
defaultPrompt: Show my personal records and progression.
